flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/daily_reports/{jobs/ClassifiedVehicleReportJob,helpers/ClassifiedVehicleReportHelper,helpers/RipHirerDriverReportHelper}, framework/schedulers/DailyReportJobsScheduler, furnish_notifications/services/FurnishNotificationServiceImpl, crud/ocmspiiezdb/EocmsFurnishApplication. ocmsadminui pages/Report/index.tsx, pages/Report/lists/ReportListRIP.tsx, pages/Dashboard/Dashboard.tsx. ocmsadminapi workflows/reports/system/rip. No dedicated classified-vehicle furnished-driver report code in the six repos
note: Status 'Requirement given - Gen flow'. No daily report on the driver particulars furnished for classified vehicle notices was found. Searching 'furnish', 'classified', 'VIP', 'driver particulars' and 'hirer' in ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminui only finds three things with a different scope: (a) ClassifiedVehicleReportJob (OCMS14.23), which has no furnish data at all, (b) the RIP Hirer/Driver Furnished report, which filters PS-RP2, not type V (RipHirerDriverReportHelper.java:45), and (c) the daily officer notification of Pending furnish applications for all notices (FurnishNotificationServiceImpl.java:146-152). The general furnish mechanism does exist and stores data in eocms_furnish_application, but it is not tied to type V, so only the first step is Sebagian. The OIC dashboard does not exist either (Dashboard.tsx is empty). No relevant maintenance tickets. Orphans: the RIP report is logged.
recommendation: Do not claim. Only the general furnish mechanism exists; the daily furnished-driver report for classified vehicles and the OIC dashboard do not. Ask URA/the team whether the RIP Hirer/Driver Furnished report is meant as a substitute, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: Driver particulars for a classified vehicle notice have been furnished and are recorded in OCMS
steps.detail: The general furnish mechanism stores submissions in the eocms_furnish_application table (EocmsFurnishApplication.java:22) with furnish_name, furnish_id_no and owner_name (FurnishNotificationServiceImpl.java:146-152). It applies to every notice and does not distinguish type V; there is no classified-vehicle check or marking (grep for vehicle_registration_type in the furnish folders: nothing). Sebagian because it is generic.

steps.step: A daily job selects classified vehicle notices whose driver particulars have been furnished
steps.detail: The daily report job list has only 7 jobs (DailyReportJobsScheduler.java:96-102, names in cron-schedules-prod.properties:262-268) and none combines type V with furnish applications. ClassifiedVehicleReportHelper only calls findAllTypeVNotices and findTypeVAmendedToS (lines 49-53), which do not join the furnish table (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:711-731). Searching 'furnish', 'driver particulars', 'classified', 'VIP' and 'hirer' in ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui found no other job.

steps.step: The report lists the driver particulars that were furnished for those notices
steps.detail: The only furnished-driver report is the RIP Hirer/Driver Furnished report, which filters PS-RP2 (RipHirerDriverReportHelper.java:45-56; menu 'RIP Hirer/Driver Furnished Report', ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/index.tsx:86-88, endpoint reports/rip/furnished-driver-hirer in ReportListRIP.tsx:74), not classified vehicle notices. The daily officer notification only contains notice number, vehicle, stage and furnish application status, without driver names (FurnishNotificationServiceImpl.java:186-197). Because the scope differs, neither is counted as evidence for this story (logged in orphans).

steps.step: The report is routed to the OIC dashboard for follow-up
steps.detail: Dashboard.tsx only renders an empty div (lines 21-32) and the Report menu has no furnished-driver report for classified vehicles (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/index.tsx:86-88 only has RIP). Since the report itself does not exist, nothing is delivered to the OIC in any form, and there is no dashboard route or endpoint in ocmsadminapi.
